text:
maria: Pushed a quick Figma for a new 'Connection health' step in the Private setup flow. The idea: run a small preflight that checks reachability + port ACLs and surface a single-pass status bar. asking for copy + accessibility nits. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/priv-setup-health

josh: :eyes: Nice. Couple thoughts: 
- We need to make color alone not the only status indicator (icons + text).
- 'All good' reads a bit casual for enterprise docs. Maybe 'Connectivity verified' instead.

aisha: Agree on wording. Suggestions:
- Success label: "Connectivity verified"
- Warning label: "Partial reachability — see details"
- Failure label: "Connection failed — troubleshooting steps"
Also can we add a one-line explainer under each label: why we need the port?

lee: Accessibility: add aria-live on the status region so screen readers announce changes during the checks. Also keyboard: the "Run checks" button needs focus outline and the details accordion should be tabbable.

sam: For the port list we should show both friendly name + actual port (e.g., Control plane (443)). And include a small copy line: "If your network team needs this, copy the full rule set" with a copy button.

maria: Good notes. For the copy button: should the clipboard show a compact rule set or full ip ranges? ops teams asked for explicit CIDRs in past.

josh: Add both: small toggle for "Compact" vs "Full (CIDRs)". Default to Compact to reduce noise. Also add a little copy tooltip: "Copies to clipboard in firewall-friendly format".

aisha: Microcopy tweak: under the retry CTA, replace "Try again" with "Re-run checks" — clearer what happens.

lee: Color contrast: the current green (#78e08f) fails some AA thresholds at small sizes. Suggest darker green and ensure the status icon has a 3px solid stroke for distinction.

maria: noted — will swap to #1ea34a for green and #d64545 for errors. Also adding an icon + text.

sam: Logging: can we add a small link to "View raw results" that opens a modal with the curl/nc outputs. Example snippet for ops:
```
# quick TCP check
nc -vz example.redwood.ai 443
# or curl for http endpoints
curl -I https://example.redwood.ai/healthz
```

maria: love it. Where should the modal be surfaced in the flow? inline under the details or as a separate tab in the firewall section?

josh: Inline modal (non-blocking) is fine. Make sure it can be opened with keyboard and that it traps focus while open. Add a close button with aria-label "Close raw results".

deploy-bot: deploy status — staging preview available at https://staging.redwood.ai/priv-setup/health-checks (build #452) :white_check_mark:

aisha: Quick copy polish: change heading from "Network checks" to "Connection health and prerequisites" — more explicit. Also add a short subhead: "These quick checks help your firewall and routing teams confirm the rules we need."

lee: One more accessibility nit: when failures occur, provide next-step links (e.g., "Show firewall rules", "Contact support"), and set role="alert" on the failure banner so ATs announce it immediately.

maria: Great — I'll update the figma and post a new link. Plan: update colors/icons, add aria-live/role=alert, change copy to the suggested strings, add compact/full toggle for copy, include raw modal with sample commands, and make retry button "Re-run checks". I'll ping again once updated.

sam: Thanks! I'll loop in infra docs to draft a short firewall snippet page to link from the modal.

josh: :thumbsup: Looks solid. Small follow-up: can we add a tiny timing estimate near the button: "Takes ~15–30s"? Saves users from thinking it's stuck.

maria: good call — adding that too.

maria: (follow-up) Updated figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/priv-setup-v2-health — new colors, copy, and modal. Please review by EOD.
